intro: You are an apprentice under Master Orrin, a Hearthwright of Millbrook. He knows a secret about your bloodline, but first he'll teach you how to survive.

steps.title: Gear Up
steps.text: Orrin tosses you an old blade. Equip it (Inventory → Vault → Equip).

steps.title: Rats in the Cellar
steps.text: The guildhall cellar in Millbrook is crawling. Open the Map tab and take 'Rats in the Cellar' (the quest pin next to Millbrook, or the Outskirts quest list below the map) for your first fight.

steps.title: Scout Nearby
steps.text: Orrin wants to know what lies around Millbrook. Gather at a nearby spot or explore an area (Map tab).

steps.title: First Craft
steps.text: At Orrin's bench, whittle a charm from 2 wood (button below, or the Crafting tab later).

steps.title: First Trade
steps.text: Sell something in a town: resources from the Map tab, or set up a trade route.

steps.title: Stretch Your Legs
steps.text: Pick any activity in the Jobs tab and do it for a few days.

steps.title: Your Own Ground
steps.text: Visit the Estate tab: one day this is where your family will live.

steps.title: Choose a Path
steps.text: Come of age (18) and choose a class (adventurer), take up a craft, or join a guild.

finale: Orrin smiles: "Your family once had a name in these lands, the Lost House. Find the ledger." The story begins.

tour.text: Main: your active member, traits, suitors, story and save tools.
Jobs: activities, jobs and training. This is what your member does each day.
Inventory: the vault, bags, equipment and foods.
Estate: land, buildings, stations and production.
Map: travel, towns, quests, dungeons and world events.
Minions: helpers who gather, craft and level up.
Guilds: join, rank up and unlock exclusive skills.
Crafting: queues and quality odds (opens once you have a crafter).
